Product description

Essentials by Novoma Brain Gummies are a simple daily routine for busy adults: two citrus-flavoured, sugar-free, caffeine-free gummies that combine 500 mg of L-tyrosine and 300 mg of acetyl-L-carnitine with vitamins B5, B9 and B12 and zinc.

Zinc contributes to normal cognitive function. Pantothenic acid contributes to normal mental performance. Folate and vitamin B12 contribute to normal psychological function and to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.

Made with pectin rather than gelatin, sweetened with polyols and stevia, and packed in the resealable Essentials pouch with a desiccant to keep every gummy fresh until the last day of your one-month course. Formulated in France by Novoma, the Toulouse supplement brand available in more than 1,500 pharmacies.

Product information

Supplement facts
Per daily portion (2 gummies)Amount% NRV*
L-Tyrosine500 mg–
Acetyl-L-Carnitine300 mg–
Pantothenic acid (vitamin B5)6 mg100%
Folate (calcium L-methylfolate)200 µg100%
Vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin)2.5 µg100%
Zinc (bisglycinate)5 mg50%
*NRV: nutrient reference values. Sugars < 0.5 g per 100 g.
Ingredients
Sweeteners (maltitol syrup, isomalt), water, gelling agent (pectin), L-tyrosine, acetyl-L-carnitine hydrochloride, acidity regulators (malic acid, citric acid), natural citrus flavouring, zinc bisglycinate, calcium D-pantothenate, glazing agent (carnauba wax), sweetener (steviol glycosides), calcium L-methylfolate, methylcobalamin. Indicative formula, to be finalised with the manufacturer.
Directions
Chew 2 gummies a day, in the morning or at lunchtime. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.
Safety information
Food supplement with sweeteners. Excessive consumption may have laxative effects. Keep out of reach of young children. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women or for people under 18. Ask your doctor before use if you take antidepressant (MAOI) or thyroid medication. Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after use.

Looking for specific info? · Ask Rufus

Does it contain caffeine?No. Essentials Brain Gummies are caffeine-free, so you can take them at any time of day.
Is it vegan? Does it contain gelatin?Yes, it is vegan. The gummies are made with pectin, not gelatin.
How many per day and how long does a pouch last?2 gummies a day. One pouch of 60 gummies lasts 30 days, i.e. €0.57 a day.
Is it sugar-free?Yes: less than 0.5 g of sugars per 100 g. It is sweetened with polyols and stevia. Excessive consumption may have laxative effects.
What is the difference from L-carnitine sold for sport?Acetyl-L-carnitine is the acetylated form of L-carnitine. Sport products usually use L-carnitine tartrate.
Can I take it with Essentials Magnesium?Yes, the two products are designed to be used side by side; respect the daily dose of each.
